svg.title: Pure Function Concept Diagram
svg.desc: Illustrates pure vs impure functions: same input → same output, no side effects
svg.text: does not read or mutate external state
Two core rules of pure functions

g.text: f(3) always returns the same value
call can be replaced by its result
I/O, global vars, DB writes NG
zero impact on the outside world

svg.text: Easy to test · Safe to parallelize · Memoizable · Easy to debug
Examples of side effects (avoided in pure functions)
· HTTP requests, DB writes, file operations
